messages:
customer_bob: Hi, hitting weird tail latency. Traces show same request sent to ap-southeast then retried to eu-central. p95 spikes. Any idea why SDK would jump regions?

maria_support: Hey @customer_bob — can you share the SDK client config and a sample of request headers/tracing IDs? We want to check region selection + retry/hedge settings.

customer_bob: Sure. App logs:
```
trace=tx-99 region=ap-southeast-1 attempt=1 timeout=200ms
retry triggered -> hedged request to eu-central-1
final response region=eu-central-1 lat=1100ms
```
Client instantiation:
```
RedwoodClient(region=None, retry_policy={"hedging":true, "max_retries":2, "initial_backoff_ms":50}, timeout_ms=200, sdk_version="0.9.3")
```

dev_jason: If region=None the client uses endpoint resolution + local preference heuristics, but with hedging enabled a timeout can launch a parallel request to another candidate region. @sre_alyssa any signs of ap-southeast degradation?

sre_alyssa: We saw elevated 503s from a small subset of ap-southeast nodes around 07:14. No full region outage, but health-checks tripped on a few shards and control-plane routing briefly rebalanced traffic.

maria_support: Two interacting behaviors: (A) the SDK hedging fires on your short timeout, (B) control-plane health signals mean the next resolved host might be in a different region. Combined -> cross-region retries.

customer_bob: We have tight latency SLOs; even a single cross-region hop is unacceptable. Recommended immediate change?

devex_ben: Short-term fix: pin region explicitly and disable hedging. Example:
```
RedwoodClient(region="ap-southeast-1", retry_policy={"hedging":false, "max_retries":1}, timeout_ms=700)
```
Also upgrade SDK 0.10.x — it includes prefer_local_hedge flag (beta) so hedges prefer same-region endpoints.

maria_support: Medium-term: you can keep hedging for reliability but set prefer_local_hedge=true and increase the initial_backoff_ms so hedges wait a bit longer before crossing regions.

customer_bob: Can you provide repro steps? I can add artificial latency to our test hosts.

maria_support: Repro steps we use internally:
1) Deploy a client with region=None and hedging=true.
2) Add a latency injector on local region hosts (sleep 150-400ms on 20% of requests).
3) Run 200 concurrent requests and capture X-Region headers and trace ids.
Expect to see some traces with multiple X-Region values when your timeout < injected tail latency.

sre_alyssa: Ops note: we can also reduce sensitivity of health-check failover window for a short maintenance window to avoid aggressive global reroutes, but that risks keeping degraded hosts in the pool.

dev_jason: Filed ENG-4976 to make "prefer_local_hedge" stable and to log hedging decision context (which candidate regions were considered). Also adjusting default timeout guidance in SDK docs.

customer_bob: Implemented region pin + hedging=false + timeout bump. Will monitor.

bot_deploy: SUPPORT ticket SUPPORT-2176 linked to ENG-4976

customer_bob: Quick update: after pinning region and disabling hedging our p95 dropped from ~1.1s to 210ms. Thanks all.
